Unmissable Outback Luxury Glamping Retreat near Kings Canyon

Petermann, Australia

Experience the majesty of Northern Territory's rugged outback with an opulent glamping stay at Kings Creek Station, nestled at the foot of stunning Watarrka (Kings Canyon). Traverse the Mars-like landscape of the hugely significant Watarrka National Park, take a day trip to awe-inspiring Uluru or relax in the comforts of your unique accommodation, which combines the iconic Australian camping experience with luxurious creature comforts. Soak up the breathtaking beauty of the awe-inspiring terrain as you enjoy the incredible onsite facilities of this cattle station, including a refreshing swimming pool with unparalleled views.
